messages.subject: TVAR.LRtest
parts:
Dear all,
I run the test of linearity in TVAR (TVAR.LRtest) and I have the problem when I run. Specifically,
When I run 
TVAR.LRtest (data[,1:4], lag = 2, thDelay = 1:2, thVar = data[,5], nboot = 1000, trim = 0.2, test = c("1vs", "2vs3"))
The results of 1vs2 and 1vs3 have been shown, but the result of 2vs3 have not. 

When I run
TVAR.LRtest (data[,1:4], lag = 2, thDelay = 1:2, thVar = data[,5], nboot = 1000, trim = 0.2, test = c("2vs3"))
I received the message: Error in if (round(z2[i - bestDelay], ndig) <= bestThresh) { :missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

I don't khow the problem I have, and how do I solve the problem?
